tokens.npc_dota_hero_bristleback_bio:
Never one to turn his back on a fight, Rigwarl was known for battling the biggest, meanest scrappers he could get his hands on. Christened Bristleback by the drunken crowds, he waded into backroom brawls in every road tavern between Slom and Elze, until his exploits finally caught the eye of a barkeep in need of an enforcer. For a bit of brew, Bristleback was hired to collect tabs, keep the peace, and break the occasional leg or two (or five, in the case of one unfortunate web-hund).

After indulging in a night of merriment during which bodily harm was meted out in equal parts upon both delinquent patrons and his own liver, Bristleback finally met his match. "Your tusks offend me, sir," he was heard to drunkenly slur to one particularly large fellow from the northern wastes whose bill had come due. What followed was a fight for the ages. A dozen fighters jumped in. No stool was left unbroken, and in the end, the impossible happened: the tab went unpaid. Over the weeks that followed, Bristleback's wounds healed, and his quills grew back; but an enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing. He paid the tab from his own coin, vowing to track down this northerner and extract redemption. And then he did something he'd never done before: he actually trained, and in so doing made a startling discovery about himself. A smile peeled back from his teeth as he flexed his quills. Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_bristleback_hype: When it comes to a fight, Bristleback really puts his back into it. Reducing all damage arriving from the rear or from the sides, he wades into battle with barely a care, spraying enemies with damaging quills and slowing snot.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_bristleback_npedesc1: Takes reduced damage when facing away from enemies

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|bonus ampin-p}}
*** {{Symbol|Facing Angle|l}} {{hi|Bristleback}} [[File:Dota2 Bristleback Bristleback Segment icon.png|84px|The ability's angles visualized.]]
**** The ability compares the incoming damage source's current position and Rigwarl's {{M|facing angle}} per damage instance.
**** With {{hi|Bristleback}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] as the centerpoint, its rear as the x-axis, covering a [[Wikipedia:Circular segment|circular segment]] with an infinite area behind Rigwarl.
**** [[File:Dota2 Bristleback Bristleback Segment Rear icon.png|84px]] The rear has the following properties:
***** {{Code|OP}} and {{Code|OQ}} are two [[Wikipedia:Line (geometry)#Ray|rays]] that defines the rear area, both point [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] and point [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] are positioned {{Code|{{#var:Bristleback value1}}}} clockwise and counterclockwise from point [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] respectively.
****** {{Code|[[Wikipedia:Angle|∠]] POQ {{=}} {{#expr:{{#explode:{{#var:Bristleback value1}}|°}}*2}}°}}
**** [[File:Dota2 Bristleback Bristleback Segment Side icon.png|84px]] The sides have the following properties:
***** The damage reduction component does not stack with the rear area.
***** Hence, the side's effective [[area-of-effect]] is {{Code|{{#expr:{{#explode:{{#var:Bristleback value2}}|°}}-{{#explode:{{#var:Bristleback value1}}|°}}}}°}} circular segment away from both {{Code|OP}} and {{Code|OQ}}.
**** Grants Rigwarl the following bonuses within the [[damage reduction]] angle:
***** Applies a generic [[incoming damage]] reduction on Rigwarl.
****** Stacks additively with other generic incoming damage manipulation source.
****** Does not affect {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]]
*** The passive ability cast has the following properties:
**** Does not interrupt Rigwarl's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
**** Releases {{A|Bristleback|Quill Spray}} of its corresponding level, explicitly when Rigwarl's '''rear''' accumulates {{#var:Bristleback type1 value1}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Bristleback type1 value1 tal}}|25tal}}) damage ([[Damage Manipulation|after all reductions]]):
***** Works independently of the passively released Quill Spray's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
***** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
*** Grants 1 {{A|Bristleback|Warpath}} stack per passive proc.
*** {{Symbol|a|Counter}}
**** The damage accumulation counter has the following properties:
**** Has no duration limit, and resets upon passively releasing Quill Spray.
**** Accumulates damage sources from all [[damage type]]s, except from the following sources:
***** {{M|HP Removal|x}} sources.
***** {{M|No-reflection}} sources.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Adds an active component to the {{A|Bristleback|Bristleback}} ability.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** The ability effects are applied as follows:
***# {{M|Disarms}}
***# {{Symbol|Target|Point}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Turn Rate}}
***#* {{Symbol|Target|Point}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|l}} {{hi|Bristleback}} [[File:Dota2 Bristleback Bristleback Segment agh icon.png|84px|The ability upgrade visualized.]]
***#* Sets the [[turn rate]], and rotates the hero model {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#explode:{{#var:Bristleback type3 value2 agh}}|°}}*{{G|tick rate}} round2}}°|agh}} per {{M|server tick}} until Rigwarl's rear completely faces the point-targeted direction.
***#* Neither requires turning nor {{M|facing angle|text=facing}} the point-targeted direction to cast the ability.
***# {{Symbol|Dot|Off}} {{#invoke:Lua|invoke|module=loop|fn=qs|0|{{#var:Bristleback type2 value2 agh}}|<nowiki>[[File:Dota2 Bristleback Quill Spray icon.png|21px|Quill Spray]] </nowiki>}}{{Symbol|Dot|Off}}
***#* Applies the following ability effects {{ValueColor||{{#var:Bristleback type2 value1 agh}}|agh}} seconds after casting:
***#** 1 {{A|Bristleback|Quill Spray}} of the corresponding level is released in {{ValueColor||{{#var:Bristleback type2 value3 agh}}|agh}}-second instances, over {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Bristleback type2 value3 agh}}*({{#var:Bristleback type2 value2 agh}}+1)}}|agh}} seconds.
***#** Rigwarl's {{M|facing angle}} is now locked. However, he can still move.
***# {{Symbol|Dot|Off}} {{#invoke:Lua|invoke|module=loop|fn=qs|0|{{#var:Bristleback type2 value2 agh}}|<nowiki>[[File:Dota2 Bristleback Quill Spray icon.png|21px|Quill Spray]] </nowiki>}}{{Symbol|Dot|On}}
***#* The active component ends {{ValueColor||{{#var:Bristleback type2 value1 agh}}|agh}} seconds after the last Quill Spray released.
***#* {{M|Turn rate|text=Turns}} Rigwarl back to the {{M|facing angle}} before casting if no other orders are issued.
*** Has the following additional properties:
**** Works independently of Quill Spray's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not additionally cost {{M|mana}}.
***** The Quill Spray intervals do not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}
**** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|bristleback_active_conical_quill_spray}}
***** The active buff cannot stack and cannot be reapplied.
***** Hence, recasting the active component while the current instance is active causes all ability effects to no longer be applied or happen until the max {{M|disarm}} duration ends.
**** {{A|Bristleback|Warpath}}
***** Grants up to {{ValueColor||{{#var:Bristleback type2 value2 agh}}|agh}} stacks per active cast.
***** Casting the active component itself does not grant stacks.
**** Can only be interrupted by {{M|Hex}} sources.
**** Both {{M|hidden}} and {{M|invulnerable}} sources applied to Rigwarl do not interrupt the active component.
**** Other {{M|disable}} sources applied may change the direction where the {{A|Bristleback|Quill Spray}} instances are released.
** All Rigwarl's ability casts have the following properties {{ValueColor||{{#var:Bristleback type2 value1 agh}}|agh}} seconds after casting:
*** Have an {{M|instant cast}} time.
*** Neither requires {{M|Turn Rate|text=turning}} nor {{M|Facing Angle|text=facing}} the targeted location or unit to cast, as long it is within the {{M|cast range}}.

abilities: Quill Spray stacks while Bristleback shrugs off frontal damage in extended fights.
Magic burst and break (Silver Edge) bypass his armor and Warpath stacks.
items: Silver Edge's Break shuts off Bristleback's passive abilities.
Spirit Vessel cuts Bristleback's healing and regeneration.
Heaven's Halberd disarms melee Bristleback for several seconds.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Bristleback's physical attacks.
Eye of Skadi's healing reduction cripples Bristleback's lifesteal.
Force Staff creates distance from melee Bristleback.
An ability upgrade for extra utility.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_bristleback
data.bio_loc:
Never one to turn his back on a fight, Rigwarl was known for battling the biggest, meanest scrappers he could get his hands on. Christened Bristleback by the drunken crowds, he waded into backroom brawls in every road tavern between Slom and Elze, until his exploits finally caught the eye of a barkeep in need of an enforcer. For a bit of brew, Bristleback was hired to collect tabs, keep the peace, and break the occasional leg or two (or five, in the case of one unfortunate web-hund).

After indulging in a night of merriment during which bodily harm was meted out in equal parts upon both delinquent patrons and his own liver, Bristleback finally met his match. "Your tusks offend me, sir," he was heard to drunkenly slur to one particularly large fellow from the northern wastes whose bill had come due. What followed was a fight for the ages. A dozen fighters jumped in. No stool was left unbroken, and in the end, the impossible happened: the tab went unpaid. Over the weeks that followed, Bristleback's wounds healed, and his quills grew back; but an enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing. He paid the tab from his own coin, vowing to track down this northerner and extract redemption. And then he did something he'd never done before: he actually trained, and in so doing made a startling discovery about himself. A smile peeled back from his teeth as he flexed his quills. Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
data.hype_loc: When it comes to a fight, Bristleback really puts his back into it. Reducing all damage arriving from the rear or from the sides, he wades into battle with barely a care, spraying enemies with damaging quills and slowing snot.
data.npe_desc_loc: Takes reduced damage when facing away from enemies

abilities.name: bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo
abilities.desc_loc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
abilities.lore_loc: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.
facets_loc: Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.

abilities.name: bristleback_quill_spray
abilities.desc_loc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.
notes_loc: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.name: bristleback_bristleback
abilities.desc_loc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
abilities.lore_loc: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
notes_loc: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.scepter_loc: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
facets_loc: Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: bristleback_hairball
abilities.desc_loc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
abilities.lore_loc: Every part of Bristleback's body is a weapon -- even the parts he accidentally swallowed.

abilities.name: bristleback_warpath
abilities.desc_loc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
abilities.lore_loc: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.
notes_loc: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
facets_loc: Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.

Warpath can be activated to grant bonus attack damage and movement speed for a short duration. While Seeing Red, Bristleback's vision is reduced to a narrow cone and he does not receive vision from his allies.

abilities.name: bristleback_prickly
abilities.desc_loc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.
